requirements.quote:
When sent by the client, the "supported_groups" extension indicates
   the named groups which the client supports for key exchange
requirements.required_behavior: list named groups the client supports for key exchange
requirements.forbidden_behavior: advertise a group the client does not support for key exchange
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted group list can be compared with the client's enabled key-exchange implementations.

requirements.quote:
The "extension_data" field of this extension contains a
   "NamedGroupList" value:
requirements.required_behavior: encode extension_data as a NamedGroupList
requirements.why_checkable: The extension parser can assert the declared message structure.

requirements.required_behavior: map secp256r1 to NamedGroup code point 0x0017
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map secp384r1 to NamedGroup code point 0x0018
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map secp521r1 to NamedGroup code point 0x0019
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map x25519 to NamedGroup code point 0x001D
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map x448 to NamedGroup code point 0x001E
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map ffdhe2048 to NamedGroup code point 0x0100
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map ffdhe3072 to NamedGroup code point 0x0101
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map ffdhe4096 to NamedGroup code point 0x0102
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map ffdhe6144 to NamedGroup code point 0x0103
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.required_behavior: map ffdhe8192 to NamedGroup code point 0x0104
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.condition: when encoding or decoding a finite-field private-use NamedGroup
requirements.required_behavior: recognize 0x01FC through 0x01FF as the ffdhe_private_use range
requirements.why_checkable: The enum range boundaries are exact wire-level constants.

requirements.condition: when encoding or decoding an elliptic-curve private-use NamedGroup
requirements.required_behavior: recognize 0xFE00 through 0xFEFF as the ecdhe_private_use range
requirements.why_checkable: The enum range boundaries are exact wire-level constants.

requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing a NamedGroupList
requirements.required_behavior: encode named_group_list as a NamedGroup vector with content length between 2 and 65535 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty vector or a vector outside the declared range
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length prefix and element parser expose the declared bounds.

requirements.quote:
Elliptic Curve Groups (ECDHE):  Indicates support for the
      corresponding named curve, defined in either FIPS 186-4 [DSS] or
      [RFC7748].
requirements.required_behavior: dispatch key exchange to the corresponding named curve definition
requirements.why_checkable: The NamedGroup value and selected curve implementation can be compared.

requirements.quote:
Finite Field Groups (DHE):  Indicates support for the corresponding
      finite field group, defined in [RFC7919].
requirements.required_behavior: dispatch key exchange to the corresponding finite-field group definition
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a different group's finite-field parameters
requirements.why_checkable: The NamedGroup value and selected finite-field parameters can be compared.

requirements.quote:
Items in named_group_list are ordered according to the sender's
   preferences (most preferred choice first).
requirements.required_behavior: order groups by sender preference with the most preferred first
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized order can be compared with configured group preferences.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST NOT act upon any information
   found in "supported_groups" prior to successful completion of the
   handshake
requirements.condition: a client receives supported_groups from the server before the handshake completes successfully
requirements.why_checkable: Client group state and subsequent key-share choices can be observed before and after handshake completion.

requirements.quote:
If the server has a
   group it prefers to the ones in the "key_share" extension but is
   still willing to accept the ClientHello, it SHOULD send
   "supported_groups" to update the client's view of its preferences
requirements.condition: the server accepts the ClientHello but prefers a group over every group in the client's key_share
requirements.required_behavior: send supported_groups to communicate the server's preferences
requirements.why_checkable: Server preference configuration, accepted shares, and emitted extensions can be compared.

requirements.quote:
this extension SHOULD contain all groups the server supports,
   regardless of whether they are currently supported by the client.
requirements.required_behavior: include every group the server supports regardless of the client's current supported groups
requirements.forbidden_behavior: filter the list down to only client-supported groups
requirements.why_checkable: The server's enabled group set can be compared with the emitted extension.
